mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before meeting with a home addition contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your consultation, clarify your primary goals, lifestyle needs, and preferred budget range. Measure your outdoor yard to identify potential footprint constraints, and locate your property survey to check easements and boundary lines. Think through how the space will connect to existing rooms and whether you need plumbing for an attached bathroom. Having a rough list of non-negotiable features—such as walk-in closets, extra electrical outlets, or specific architectural styles—helps the contractor provide an accurate initial evaluation and project estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, identify your budget range, determine your functional room needs, and list non-negotiable features such as added bathrooms or specific layouts.
